name: Tour du Mont Blanc - Itinéraire principal
description_md:
Tour du Mont Blanc - Itinéraire principal is a waymarked hiking route in France. The shape of the route starts and finishes at the same place.

The distance is 83.8 km with 2674 m of ascent and 2787 m of descent. Walking time is about 21 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, and difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent. It is signposted as TMB-IP on a regional waymarked hiking network. The official route matches the line published by ign_bdtopo, passing Chamonix-Mont-Blanc within 100 m and Église Saint-Nicolas-de-Véroce de Saint-Gervais-les-Bains within 800 m.
